data.gender_notes: Vibhavati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vibhavati is the goddess of prosperity and wealth in Hindu mythology. The name Vibhavati carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vibhavati usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Vibhavati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhavati total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vibhavati signifies the Hindu belief in the importance of material wealth and prosperity in one's life. It is a reminder of the Hindu tradition that values both material and spiritual well-being. The name is often used in Hindu marriages and other religious ceremonies to invoke the blessings of the goddess of prosperity, Lakshmi, who is commonly referred to as Vibhavati.
data.spiritual_significance: Vibhavati also represents the spiritual belief in the abundant grace and blessings of the divine. It is a reminder that material wealth and prosperity come from the divine and that one should be grateful for the provisions of the universe. The name encourages an attitude of contentment and appreciation for the blessings of the divine, rather than attachment or greed.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vibhavati symbolizes the infinite expansion and manifestation of the divine within oneself. Her name, derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vibhava' (manifestation) and 'ati' (beyond), signifies the transcendence of limitations and the realization of the infinite potential within.
